Apple___Apple_scab.description: A common fungal disease that causes dark, scabby spots on leaves and fruit, reducing fruit quality.
Apple___Apple_scab.recommended_action: Remove fallen leaves, prune infected branches, and apply fungicides like Captan or Mancozeb early in the season.

Apple___Black_rot.description: A fungal disease that causes circular brown spots on leaves and black, shriveled fruit known as mummies.
Apple___Black_rot.recommended_action: Prune and destroy infected limbs and fruit. Apply copper-based fungicide before bloom.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: A fungal disease causing yellow-orange spots on apple leaves, requiring both apple and cedar trees to complete its lifecycle.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.recommended_action: Remove nearby cedar trees if possible. Apply protective fungicides during spring when spores are active.

Apple___healthy.description: No disease detected. The apple plant appears healthy with no visible symptoms.
Apple___healthy.recommended_action: Continue regular monitoring and maintain good cultural practices including proper spacing, watering, and fertilization.

Blueberry___healthy.description: No disease detected. The blueberry plant appears healthy.
Blueberry___healthy.recommended_action: Continue regular care with proper watering, mulching, and annual pruning to maintain plant health.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.description: A fungal disease creating white powdery coating on leaves, shoots, and fruit, reducing photosynthesis.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.recommended_action: Improve air circulation by pruning. Apply sulfur-based or potassium bicarbonate fungicides at first sign of infection.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.description: No disease detected. The cherry plant appears healthy.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.recommended_action: Maintain good sanitation, proper watering, and monitor regularly for early detection of any issues.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.description: A fungal disease causing rectangular gray to brown lesions on corn leaves, reducing yield.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.recommended_action: Use resistant hybrids, practice crop rotation, and apply azoxystrobin or pyraclostrobin fungicides if severe.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.description: A fungal disease producing orange-brown pustules on corn leaves, most common in cool, humid conditions.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.recommended_action: Plant resistant varieties. Apply triazole or strobilurin fungicides if infection is severe during critical growth stages.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.description: A fungal disease causing long, cigar-shaped gray-green lesions on corn leaves, significantly reducing yield.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.recommended_action: Use resistant hybrids, rotate crops, and apply propiconazole or azoxystrobin fungicides preventatively.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.description: No disease detected. The corn plant appears healthy.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.recommended_action: Continue proper spacing, adequate fertilization, and monitor for pests and diseases throughout growing season.

Grape___Black_rot.description: A serious fungal disease causing circular brown leaf spots and shriveled black berries.
Grape___Black_rot.recommended_action: Remove mummified fruit and infected canes. Apply mancozeb or myclobutanil from bud break through fruit set.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).description: A complex fungal disease causing tiger-stripe leaf patterns and wood decay in older vines.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).recommended_action: Prune out infected wood during dormant season. No chemical cure exists; focus on prevention and vine health.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.description: A fungal disease causing angular brown spots on grape leaves, leading to premature defoliation.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.recommended_action: Improve air circulation through canopy management. Apply copper-based fungicides or mancozeb.

Grape___healthy.description: No disease detected. The grape plant appears healthy.
Grape___healthy.recommended_action: Maintain proper pruning, training, and spray programs to prevent diseases. Monitor regularly.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).description: A devastating bacterial disease transmitted by psyllids, causing yellow shoots, misshapen fruit, and eventual tree death.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).recommended_action: Remove infected trees immediately. Control psyllid vectors with insecticides. Use certified disease-free nursery stock.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.description: A bacterial disease causing small dark spots on leaves and fruit, leading to defoliation and unmarketable fruit.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.recommended_action: Apply copper sprays during dormancy and oxytetracycline during growing season. Plant resistant varieties.

Peach___healthy.description: No disease detected. The peach plant appears healthy.
Peach___healthy.recommended_action: Continue regular monitoring, proper pruning for air circulation, and preventive spray programs.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.description: A bacterial disease causing dark, greasy spots on leaves and fruit, reducing yield and quality.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.recommended_action: Use disease-free seeds, practice crop rotation, and apply copper-based bactericides weekly.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.description: No disease detected. The bell pepper plant appears healthy.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.recommended_action: Maintain consistent watering, proper spacing for air flow, and monitor for early signs of disease or pests.

Potato___Early_blight.description: A fungal disease causing target-like brown spots on lower leaves, progressing upward and reducing yield.
Potato___Early_blight.recommended_action: Remove infected foliage, apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb fungicides, and practice 3-year crop rotation.

Potato___Late_blight.description: A devastating disease causing water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems, can destroy entire crops rapidly.
Potato___Late_blight.recommended_action: Apply preventive fungicides (chlorothalonil, mancozeb). Destroy infected plants immediately. Use resistant varieties.

Potato___healthy.description: No disease detected. The potato plant appears healthy.
Potato___healthy.recommended_action: Use certified disease-free seed potatoes, practice crop rotation, and monitor fields regularly.

Raspberry___healthy.description: No disease detected. The raspberry plant appears healthy.
Raspberry___healthy.recommended_action: Maintain proper pruning of old canes, ensure good air circulation, and monitor for diseases.

Soybean___healthy.description: No disease detected. The soybean plant appears healthy.
Soybean___healthy.recommended_action: Continue proper crop rotation, monitor for insects and diseases, and maintain optimal soil fertility.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.description: A fungal disease creating white powdery coating on leaves, reducing photosynthesis and fruit quality.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.recommended_action: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate fungicides. Improve air circulation and avoid overhead watering.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.description: A fungal disease causing purple-bordered spots that merge, giving leaves a scorched appearance.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.recommended_action: Remove and destroy infected leaves. Apply captan or myclobutanil fungicides. Ensure good air circulation.

Strawberry___healthy.description: No disease detected. The strawberry plant appears healthy.
Strawberry___healthy.recommended_action: Remove old leaves after fruiting, maintain proper spacing, and use disease-free planting material.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.description: A bacterial disease causing small dark spots with yellow halos on leaves and fruit.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.recommended_action: Use disease-resistant varieties, apply copper-based bactericides, and avoid overhead irrigation.

Tomato___Early_blight.description: A fungal disease causing concentric ring spots on lower leaves, progressing upward.
Tomato___Early_blight.recommended_action: Remove affected leaves, apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb, mulch to prevent soil splash, and stake plants.

Tomato___Late_blight.description: A serious fungal disease causing large brown blotches on leaves and fruit, can destroy crops quickly.
Tomato___Late_blight.recommended_action: Apply preventive fungicides (chlorothalonil, mancozeb). Remove infected plants immediately. Improve air circulation.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.description: A fungal disease causing yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces and fuzzy growth underneath, common in humid conditions.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.recommended_action: Improve greenhouse ventilation, reduce humidity, apply chlorothalonil fungicide, and use resistant varieties.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.description: A fungal disease causing numerous small circular spots with gray centers on leaves.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.recommended_action: Remove infected leaves, apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb, mulch soil, and practice crop rotation.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.description: Tiny arachnids that cause stippling, yellowing, and webbing on leaves, sucking plant sap.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.recommended_action: Spray with neem oil or insecticidal soap. Increase humidity. Use predatory mites for biological control.

Tomato___Target_Spot.description: A fungal disease causing target-like brown spots on leaves, stems, and fruit.
Tomato___Target_Spot.recommended_action: Apply chlorothalonil or azoxystrobin fungicides. Remove infected plant debris and improve air circulation.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: A viral disease transmitted by whiteflies, causing upward leaf curling, yellowing, and stunted growth.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.recommended_action: Control whitefly vectors with insecticides or yellow sticky traps. Remove infected plants. Use virus-resistant varieties.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: A viral disease causing mottled light and dark green patterns on leaves, distorted growth, and reduced yield.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.recommended_action: Remove infected plants immediately. Disinfect tools. Plant resistant varieties. Control aphid vectors.

Tomato___healthy.description: No disease detected. The tomato plant appears healthy.
Tomato___healthy.recommended_action: Maintain proper spacing, stake or cage plants, water at base, and monitor regularly for early disease detection.
